<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
	<description>4bit unsigned number pipeline multiplier</description>
	<ports>
		<input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
		<input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for chip reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
		<input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">Input signal representing the multiplicand with a data width of 'size' bits.</input>
		<input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">Input signal representing the multiplier with a data width of 'size' bits.</input>
		<output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Product output signal with a data width of 2*size bits.</output>
	endports
	
	<parameter_description>
		<param id="size" value="4"/> <!-- Parameter representing the size of the input operands -->
	endparameter_description
	
	<implementation>
		<!-- Extend input signals to fit the multiplication operation -->
		wire [size-1:0] mul_a_ext;
		wire [size-1:0] mul_b_ext;
		
		assign mul_a_ext = {mul_a[size-1],mul_a};
		assign mul_b_ext = {mul_b[size-1],mul_b}; // Extend input signals
		
		// Define registers to hold partial products
		reg [2*size-1:0] pp_reg[0:size-1];
		// Generate loop to create partial products based on the multiplier's bits
		genvar i;
		generate
			for(i=0;i<size;i=i+1) begin : pp_gen_loop
				always@(posedge clk,negedge rst_n)begin
					if(!rst_n)begin
						pp_reg[i]<=0;
					end else if(mul_b_ext[i]==1'b1)begin
						pp_reg[i]<={mul_a_ext,i}; // Left shift the multiplicand by i positions
					end else begin
						pp_reg[i]<=0; // Set the register to 0 if the bit is 0
					end
				end
			end
		endgenerate
		
		// Register to hold intermediate sums
		reg [2*size-1:0] sreg[0:size-1]; // Array of registers to hold sums
		
		integer j,k,l;
		// Combinational logic for adding partial products in pipelined stages
		always@(*)begin
			sreg[0]=pp_reg[0];
			for(j=1;j<size;j=j+1)begin
				sreg[j]=sreg[j-1]+pp_reg[j];
			end
		end
		// Output register to hold the final product
		reg [2*size-1:0] mul_out_reg;
		
		// Assign the final product output
		always@(posedge clk,negedge rst_n)begin
			if(!rst_n)begin
				mul_out_reg<=0; // Reset the output register
			end else begin
				mul_out_reg</implementation></parameter_description></ports></module>
